title: Flood Premium-Change Loading After a Withdrawn Flood Bill
content:
Where a flood bill of a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts has been withdrawn, the flood premium-change loading compares the replacement billing with the withdrawn billing. The flood bills of the review are the flood insurance bills on file for the reserve received no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

1. At least one flood bill of the review withdrawn, and the paid and received flood bills of the review summing to more than the withdrawn flood bills of the review increased by the premium-change threshold percentage, 10.0 percent: the high premium-change loading, 8.0 percent.
2. At least one withdrawn, and the paid and received flood bills summing to more than the withdrawn flood bills but not more than that threshold: the low premium-change loading, 4.0 percent.
3. Otherwise: no premium-change loading under this rule.

*Hypothetical:* withdrawn flood bills totalling 600.00 put the threshold point at 660.00. Paid and received flood bills of 700.00 give 8.0 percent; 660.00 or 630.00 give 4.0 percent; 600.00 gives none.
